selections.heading: Corrections
selections.text: MFA was a typo for MCA. Four blocks: McaInitialisation replaces the SQLite file from that day's MCA and applies no CFA

selections.heading: Corrections
selections.text: NetworkPage asks on open and on each interval even when the station boxes are empty. StationPairPage asks only when both boxes are non-empty. Unmatched codes are a successful empty list.

selections.heading: Forbidden
selections.text: The earlier rule that the reader never rewrites SQLite still binds TimetableQuery. McaInitialisation is the exception and replaces the file.

selections.heading: Corrections
selections.text: The pair page reads StationSelection and RefreshInterval owned by NetworkPage. That reference is not a call, so the call graph stays acyclic.

selections.heading: Corrections
